strategies.name: Block-Partitioned Independent Streams

strategies.name: All-Gather + Local Reduce

Dispatch count = 1 all-gather. Trades 8 all-reduce dispatches for 1 larger all-gather plus O(world_size) local memory and compute; wins if dispatch latency dominates over bandwidth.
